description: Bohr atom diagram for Hydrogen: 1 electron, 1 proton, 0 neutrons — the simplest element.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_chemistry import BohrAtom

class BohrAtomHydrogen(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        atom = BohrAtom(e=1, p=1, n=0)
        label = Text("Hydrogen", font_size=28).next_to(atom, DOWN)
        self.add(atom, label)
        self.wait(0.5)
